title.zh: Bloomberg Terminal Adds 24/7 Hyperliquid Perpetuals Pricing
title.en: Bloomberg Terminal Adds 24/7 Hyperliquid Perpetuals Pricing

current_state.zh: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.
